business.title: WHAT IS KOWA'S BUSINESS?
business.intro: Kowa runs a resource-circulation trading model centered on plastics recycling, industrial support, and cross-border supply operations.

flowPhases.title: Purchase & Collection
flowPhases.step: Purchase and collect production-loss materials and waste plastic.
flowPhases.detail: The source flow starts with intake from resin production loss, waste plastic, mixed plastic, and processing-loss material before the line moves into sorting.

flowPhases.title: Sorting & Dismantling
flowPhases.step: Sort and dismantle by resin, ingredient blend, and material condition.
flowPhases.detail: Kowa separates incoming material before processing so different resin streams and blended inputs can move into the correct crushing and regeneration path.

flowPhases.title: Crushing & Regeneration
flowPhases.step: Crush, compress, blend, and regenerate into reusable raw material.
flowPhases.detail: The documented process centers on crushing machines, compression equipment, and ribbon-mixer handling that convert plastic inputs back into reusable raw material.

flowPhases.title: Export / Domestic Sales
flowPhases.step: Route regenerated material to export, overseas supply, and domestic sales.
flowPhases.detail: The final stage is outbound circulation: export lanes, overseas supply, and domestic sales after material has been processed into usable feedstock.

companyProfile.title: Our Business
companyProfile.summary: We collect and process various types out of specification, post-consumer and industrial waste plastics within Japan, exporting them to overseas markets, primarily in Southeast Asia.
companyProfile.introTitle: We collect and process various types of waste plastics within Japan, exporting them to overseas markets.
companyProfile.introBody:
We collect and process various types out of specification, post-consumer and industrial waste plastics within Japan, exporting them to overseas markets, primarily in Southeast Asia. These materials are reprocessed locally into various products and shipped worldwide.

To strengthen our domestic operations, we established and now operate our own recycling factory, GP Polymer Co., Ltd., and joint venture factory, Green Eco Technology Co., Ltd. By crushing and recycling waste materials and production losses purchased from our corporate partners, we successfully recirculate valuable resources.

The waste plastics we source have become an indispensable asset to local industries in destination countries, driving job creation and supporting community stability.

statements.text: 当社は、日々の生活環境から発生する様々な規格外及び廃プラスチックを国内で回収・加工し、東南アジアをはじめとする海外市場へ輸出しています。これらは現地で再加工され、新たな製品として世界中へ出荷されています。さらに、自社再生工場（ジー・ピー・ポリマー株式会社）と合弁工場(ジー・イー・ティー株式会社)を設立・稼働させ、輸出に留まらず国内でのリサイクル事業にも注力しています。企業様から買い取らせていただいた廃棄プラスチックやロス材を粉砕・再資源化することで、価値ある資源の国内循環を実現しています。当社の事業は、輸出先における現地産業の発展に不可欠な存在となっており、雇用の拡大や生活の安定など、多角的な形で地域社会の発展に貢献しています。

companyProfile.timelineIntro: The chronology shows Kowa evolving from a trading company into a warehouse, factory, and large-scale plastics processing operator.

timeline.title: Corporate reorganization
timeline.detail: Increased capital to 10 million yen and reorganized into Kowa Trade and Commerce Co., Ltd. to handle the import and export of plastic materials.

timeline.title: Gunma Distribution Center

timeline.title: Gunma factory and G.P. Polymer

whatWeDo.subtitle: Kowa's trading lines
whatWeDo.statement: We collect plastics domestically and export them overseas. The exported plastics are reprocessed into various products and shipped worldwide. Kowa has established and operates a crushing factory, G.P. Polymer, and is also focusing on remanufacturing in Japan.

categories.plastics: Domestic collection through export: waste and loss plastics are sorted, crushed, and regenerated into pellet-form material through our G.P. Polymer line.
categories.generalGoods: Cross-border sourcing and distribution of general merchandise, moved through the same trading and logistics network as our plastics business.
categories.foods: Trade support for food-related goods, handled with the same disciplined sourcing and shipment coordination as our other lines.
categories.ffe: Furniture, fixtures, and equipment sourced and distributed for commercial and industrial buyers.
categories.timber: Solid Myanmar teak flooring, milled at a Yangon partner factory from government-licensed logs and imported direct.
